brief: Inspect and rectify the conservator level low and clean the radiator fins heavily fouled with dust and pollen, airflow visibly reduced, while addressing the outstanding defect notice from the last inspection round. Because this unit has a history of high loading and is of advanced age, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure if it cannot be attended before the event [MG-023]. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified [MG-021].
